title: Syrian-Style Fried Pork Chops
description: A delicious and flavorful dish that marries traditional Syrian spices with the crispy goodness of fried pork. Serve with a side of rice or vegetables for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: Syrian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, mix together flour, Syrian spice blend, and a pinch of salt.
2. Dip each pork chop into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
3. Dip the floured pork chop into the beaten egg, making sure to coat completely.
4. Roll the egg-coated pork chop in the panko breadcrumbs to coat.
5. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. When the oil is hot, add 2-3 coated pork chops to the skillet.
7. Fry the pork chops for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
8. Repeat with the remaining pork chops.
